edges.reason: BuyTickets performs a low-level ETH send to the winner before updating totalPaidOut and winner arrays, enabling reentrancy
_sender, which is only loosely bound to tx.origin, is the recipient of the ETH send
payable address add is constructed from _sender and passed to send
totalToPay is the ETH amount passed to the winner send
contract balance snapshot feeds the win amount multiplication
percentWin is a factor in the unchecked win amount computation
winAmount is the minuend of the totalToPay subtraction that can underflow
stakeHoldersfee is subtracted from winAmount and can exceed it, underflowing totalToPay
totalToPay local is assigned the subtraction result
stakeHoldersfee is used in the unchecked valueStakeHolder multiplication/division
valueStakeHolder local receives the stake holder fee result
ethfee is multiplied by the ticket count without overflow checks
user-controlled _max[0] scales the ethfee multiplication
totalEthfee local receives the multiplication result used in the payment requirement
mnefee is multiplied by the ticket count without overflow checks
user-controlled _max[0] scales the mnefee multiplication
totalMneFee local receives the mnefee multiplication result
valueStakeHolder ETH value is forwarded in the external MNE Payment call, which can re-enter before totalSentToStakeHolders is updated
The mne state variable targets the external Payment call
totalSentToStakeHolders is incremented by valueStakeHolder after the external call
totalPaidOut is incremented by totalToPay after the ETH send
transferFundsOut is gated on msg.sender being owner
msg.sender compared to owner controls the fund drain branch
transferFundsOut sends the entire contract balance via low-level send without a reentrancy guard
updateFees only executes when msg.sender equals owner
updateSystemNumber only executes when msg.sender equals owner
updateMaxNumber only executes when msg.sender equals owner
updatePercentWin only executes when msg.sender equals owner
updateMNEContract only executes when msg.sender equals owner
updateFees writes the _stakeHoldersfee parameter into stakeHoldersfee
updateFees writes the _mnefee parameter into mnefee
updateFees writes the _ethfee parameter into ethfee
updateSystemNumber writes the _systemNumber parameter into systemNumber
updateMaxNumber writes the _maxNumber parameter into maxNumber
updatePercentWin writes the _percentWin parameter into percentWin
updateMNEContract replaces the mne state variable with _mneAddress
constructor sets owner to msg.sender, establishing the privilege boundary
BuyTickets requires msg.sender to be the MNE contract, but the real authorization uses tx.origin
require(tx.origin == _sender) authorizes tickets based on tx.origin, allowing phishing-style relay
tx.origin is compared against the _sender parameter to select the payout beneficiary
block.timestamp is read and persisted to winnerTimestamp/lostTimestamp arrays
systemNumber is compared against the pseudo-randomly generated numbers
maxNumber is the modulo bound of the weak randomness expression
generated pseudo-random values are stored in the numbers memory array
a generated number matching systemNumber sets the win flag
loop counter i indexes the numbers array during generation
BuyTickets pushes the winner address into the winner array
BuyTickets pushes the loser address into the lost array
winnerLength returns winner.length
lossesLength returns lost.length
